About the role - Senior Web Developer

We are looking for an experienced Web Developer to join our core product team. You will be responsible for architecting and building high-performance web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks.

Qualifications

  • Candidate must possess bachelor's degree (in Computer Science, IT, or related fields).
  • At least 5 years of experience in front-end development using React, Vue, or Angular.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and modern CSS architectures (Tailwind, SCSS).
  • Trustworthy, detail-oriented, and can work with minimal supervision in a hybrid setup.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs and state management.

Job Descriptions

  • Develop new user-facing features and build reusable code and libraries for future use.
  • Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs.
  • Optimize application for maximum speed and scalability.
  • Collaborate with other team members and stakeholders (backend developers, designers).

Metro Manila Subway Project Reaches 45% Completion Milestone

Dept. of Transportation (DOTr)
Official Government Release

The highly anticipated Metro Manila Subway Project (MMSP) has officially reached a significant 45% completion rate, keeping the multi-billion peso infrastructure project on track for its partial operability target.

During a site inspection earlier today, officials confirmed that the tunneling works for the northern segment have accelerated due to the deployment of additional Tunnel Boring Machines (TBMs). Once completed, the 33-kilometer underground rail line will connect Valenzuela City to FTI in Taguig City, extending further to Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) Terminal 3.

Economic Impact and Commuter Benefits

The subway is expected to significantly ease traffic congestion along EDSA and other major thoroughfares. It is projected to serve over 370,000 passengers daily in its first year of full operations, cutting travel time from Quezon City to NAIA from an exhausting two hours to just 35 minutes.

"This project represents a monumental leap in our public transport modernization. The Metro Manila Subway is not just a train line; it is an economic catalyst that will redefine urban mobility in the capital region."

The government remains committed to ensuring transparent procurement and strict adherence to construction safety protocols. Residents near the construction sites are continually updated regarding noise and traffic advisories via the Kayumanggi dashboard.
